title: Venezuelan Cheese Quesadilla
description: A malty, shattering, comforting Venezuelan dish featuring shredded Mexican cheese, katsuramuki-cut, satvik-friendly. This recipe is a twist on traditional Venezuelan cuisine with a Mexican touch.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced onion, bell pepper, and tomato, and cook until the vegetables are tender.
In a large bowl, combine the shredded cheese, cumin, and paprika.
Place a large tortilla in the skillet and sprinkle one quarter of the cheese mixture onto half of the tortilla.
Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the cheese.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortilla is crispy and the cheese is melted.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also crispy and the cheese is melted.
Repeat with the remaining tortillas and cheese mixture.
Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve hot.
